name: exclude self and existing friends
input: triangle plus a new two-hop candidate

name: ties and top k
input: equal counts use lexical candidate IDs

name: deduplicate adjacency entries and preserve input
test:
import copy
g = {'a':['b','b','c'], 'b':['a','d','d'], 'c':['a','d'], 'd':['b','c']}
before = copy.deepcopy(g)
assert recommend_friends(g, 'a', 10) == [('d', 2, 1.0)]
assert g == before

name: no recommendations
input: isolated user, no new two-hop user, and k=0
test:
assert recommend_friends({'a':[]}, 'a', 3) == []
g = {'a':['b'], 'b':['a']}
assert recommend_friends(g, 'a', 3) == []
assert recommend_friends(g, 'a', 0) == []
